text: You have not played for a long time, I said; you ought, then, to have a good hand.” “Well, what then?” “Well; the Englishman and his companion are still here. I remarked that he regretted the horse furniture very much. You appear to think much of your horse. In your place I would stake the furniture against the horse.” “But he will not wish for only one harness.” “Stake both, pardieu! I am not selfish, as you are.” “You would do so?” said D’Artagnan, undecided, so strongly did the confidence of Athos begin to prevail, in spite of himself.
